recognize_zh: 視野正中央有一顆比周圍顆粒球大好幾倍的細胞，細胞質深藍色、周緣冒出多個像「狗耳朵」的細胞質小突起（pseudopodia/blebs），核圓、染色質細而開。周圍幾乎只見顆粒球系、看不到成熟中的紅血球前驅細胞，是 parvovirus B19 巨大原紅血球的典型樣子。
features: Single giant cell roughly 3–4 times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Large round nucleus with finely dispersed, open chromatin and a pale central inclusion-like/nucleolar area
Moderate rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone
Multiple knob-like cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopodia ('dog ears') along the cell border
Background aspirate dominated by maturing granulocytes with conspicuous paucity of later erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows adequate cellularity composed predominantly of maturing granulocytic elements; maturing erythroid precursors are markedly reduced. A single giant proerythroblast is present, several times the size of neighboring neutrophils, with a large round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin and a pale central inclusion-like area. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic with a paler perinuclear zone and multiple ear-like cytoplasmic blebs. Findings are consistent with a giant proerythroblast of parvovirus B19 infection with pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows erythroid hyperplasia with many large maturing precursors and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, not a solitary giant proerythroblast with absent erythroid maturation.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of pronormoblasts (≥80% erythroid, ≥30% proerythroblasts) with vacuolated cytoplasm rather than rare giant cells in an erythroid-depleted marrow.
Tumor cells tend to form cohesive clusters with irregular nuclei, whereas this is an isolated cell with round nucleus and erythroid-type deep basophilic cytoplasm.
Megakaryoblasts may show cytoplasmic blebs but are usually smaller with scant cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b positive rather than E-cadherin/glycophorin positive.
